verdict.rationale: The README describes llama.cpp as a plain C/C++ implementation without any dependencies and points to an official build guide for cloning and building from source. Community users corroborate this: one praises not needing "a billion python/c/cpp dependencies", one got it working on an M1 trivially, and one compiled it from source for vision use. missing for 10: details in the pack on the build toolchain and steps (only a link to docs/build.md), and any account of extra dependencies needed for GPU backends such as CUDA, HIP or Metal.
